questions.question: Thabo ran 100 m in 16 seconds, Lerato in 15 seconds and Sipho in 18 seconds. Who won, and why?
questions.expected_answer: Lerato won, because she took the shortest time, 15 seconds. In a race the fastest runner takes the least time. Thabo was second and Sipho third.

questions.question: How many days are in each month of a year that is not a leap year, and how many days in the year?
questions.expected_answer: January 31, February 28, March 31, April 30, May 31, June 30, July 31, August 31, September 30, October 31, November 30, December 31. The total is 365 days.

questions.question: If 1 March is a Sunday, explain how to find the day of the week for 24 March.
questions.expected_answer: Count on in sevens: 8, 15 and 22 March are also Sundays. 24 March is 2 days after Sunday 22 March, so it is a Tuesday.
